claim_statement: Dark matter, plasma, material preferred frames, and fundamental preferred-frame fields answer different operational questions and may overlap only in a declared model.
assumptions_or_boundary: Definitions are operational and do not assert a unique ontology.
observable_or_endpoint: Stress closure; charge response; density-dependent frame; vacuum preferred-frame mode.
null_model: One label is treated as a synonym for all others.
falsifier_or_next_test: Write one action and show which observables establish each role without importing evidence between them.
limitations: A taxonomy is not evidence that any hidden sector exists.

claim_statement: The geometric closure residual is conserved when the declared known sector is separately conserved.
assumptions_or_boundary: General relativity; Bianchi identity; minimally coupled separately conserved known sector.
observable_or_endpoint: Density; momentum; pressure; anisotropic stress components of the residual.
null_model: Unmodeled known matter or modified gravity can occupy the same bookkeeping slot.
falsifier_or_next_test: Reconstruct the full covariant residual and audit known-sector incompleteness.
limitations: Conservation does not establish material ontology.

claim_statement: Charge-conjugation symmetry makes the mixed linear responses between charge-even stress and charge-odd current vanish.
assumptions_or_boundary: Dynamics, state, background, and regulator preserve charge conjugation; linear response.
observable_or_endpoint: Mixed retarded susceptibilities chi_TJ and chi_JT.
null_model: Asymmetry, background field, streaming, unequal populations, or nonlinear response.
falsifier_or_next_test: Introduce one controlled symmetry-breaking parameter and verify the predicted leading mixed response.
limitations: Independent review and prior-art comparison remain pending.

claim_statement: The declared neutral equal-pair fluid benchmark separates into Jeans-like and Langmuir-like branches.
assumptions_or_boundary: Equal and opposite charges; neutral homogeneous background; equal specific pressure response; declared closure.
observable_or_endpoint: Mode frequencies, residues, damping, and eigenvectors.
null_model: Unequal pressure response or symmetry breaking mixes mass and charge modes.
falsifier_or_next_test: Replay the linearization and recover both limiting branches plus the generic mixing terms.
limitations: Not a kinetic or cosmological solution and not an empirical dark-sector result.

claim_statement: For the self-gravitating equal-pair benchmark, the plasma-to-Jeans frequency ratio is alpha_D divided by G m squared and is density independent.
assumptions_or_boundary: Same density appears in both declared characteristic frequencies; natural-unit conventions stated in the note.
observable_or_endpoint: Omega_p squared divided by omega_J squared.
null_model: Additional species, unequal masses, screening, or changed closure alters the relation.
falsifier_or_next_test: Check dimensions and reproduce under explicit unit conventions and a generic two-species extension.
limitations: A scale ratio does not show that the sector is realized in nature.

claim_statement: One minimal gauged U(1) realization does not automatically provide both a long-range plasma and an ungapped condensate phonon.
assumptions_or_boundary: The condensed field carries the same unbroken gauge charge that supplies the long-range interaction.
observable_or_endpoint: Gauge-boson mass; screening length; Goldstone spectrum.
null_model: Additional symmetry, neutral condensate, multiple components, or phase separation.
falsifier_or_next_test: Specify the full symmetry-breaking pattern and compute the physical spectrum.

claim_statement: One LZ recoil candidate does not establish a population-level dark-matter law or a collective incoming mode.
assumptions_or_boundary: Event interpretation, detector response, background, and look-elsewhere structure remain model-assisted.
observable_or_endpoint: Recoil energy, target dependence, time, direction, and additional exposure.
falsifier_or_next_test: Supply a prospective interaction operator and spectral weight S_D(q,omega) that transfers across targets and exposures.
limitations: The event status can change with later collaboration analyses.

claim_statement: A prescribed FLRW control can return to its initial scale while a minimally coupled scalar state retains nonzero Bogoliubov occupation.
assumptions_or_boundary: Free massless minimally coupled scalar; prescribed asymptotically static pulse; stated limits.
observable_or_endpoint: Mode occupation N_lambda equals absolute beta_lambda squared.
null_model: Massless conformally coupled scalar or a genuine adiabatic limit suppresses production.
falsifier_or_next_test: Reproduce the connection coefficients and scan coupling, pulse shape, dwell time, and switching rate.
limitations: No backreaction, metric source, observation, abundance, or dark-matter inference is supplied.

claim_statement: The gravity-pulse paper's threshold is a finite-occupation threshold rather than a no-production cutoff.
assumptions_or_boundary: The reported limit has absolute beta over alpha squared tending to one below threshold.
observable_or_endpoint: N equals r divided by one minus r.
null_model: A finite regulator or backreaction can change the singular limit.
falsifier_or_next_test: Recompute finite-duration spectra and close the energy budget before interpreting the infrared regime.
limitations: Applies to the paper's specific model and asymptotic limit.

claim_statement: The reported conventional and microwave SnO2 Arrhenius pairs partially cancel at the illustrative 410 K pivot.
assumptions_or_boundary: Uses the paper's apparent best-fit E_a and A values and R in consistent units.
observable_or_endpoint: Delta ln k at a pivot temperature; joint A-E_a covariance.
null_model: Broad held-out temperature data independently identify both parameters.
falsifier_or_next_test: Report covariance and held-out rates across a wider temperature range.
limitations: Rounded source values support a pivot comparison, not a covariance or identifiability claim.

claim_statement: The microwave crystallization result does not uniquely establish a nonthermal field-specific mechanism.
assumptions_or_boundary: Probe temperature may not equal the full local space-time thermal field.
observable_or_endpoint: Matched thermal history; hazard; PDF pathway; final structure.
null_model: Conventional heating with a matched local thermal field reproduces all endpoints.
falsifier_or_next_test: Measure local temperature and sweep frequency, duty cycle, peak field, and absorbed energy prospectively.
limitations: The source reports comparative rather than absolute Arrhenius parameters.

claim_statement: 450P/LONEOS was observed transitioning from an apparently point-like state to a coma, and JWST detected CO2 while reporting H2O and CO limits.
assumptions_or_boundary: Instrument reductions and source paper uncertainty are accepted at citation level, not independently replayed.
observable_or_endpoint: Images, gas production rate, upper limits, dust, and morphology.
falsifier_or_next_test: Replay calibrated data products and score multi-epoch spectra and morphology.
limitations: Observation does not directly identify the activation cause.

claim_statement: A 1992 Saturn encounter followed by altered insolation and thermal memory is a model-supported activation hypothesis for 450P.
assumptions_or_boundary: Astrometric covariance, declared N-body model, clone stability interval, and simplified thermal properties.
observable_or_endpoint: Encounter branch; semimajor-axis jump; delayed activity; thermal threshold.
null_model: Alternative orbit solutions, pure CO2 sublimation, or selection effects.
falsifier_or_next_test: Use current covariance and multiple integrators, then freeze one thermophysical model across all epochs and matched controls.
limitations: No end-to-end likelihood maps the encounter to the measured CO2 rate.

claim_statement: Endpoint restoration, parameter compensation, latent history, and observation operators form a useful four-part audit before naming a residual.
assumptions_or_boundary: The calibration cases transfer only at the inference-architecture level.
observable_or_endpoint: Cross-protocol held-out prediction after explicit null subtraction.
null_model: Existing standard models close the residual.
falsifier_or_next_test: Predeclare the four audits and test whether they prevent false mechanism attribution on benchmark datasets.
limitations: Novelty and utility are unknown until independently compared and tested.

claim_statement: The three calibration cases do not establish a shared plasma, aether, or dark-matter substance.
assumptions_or_boundary: No shared action, carrier, coupling, units, or transfer prediction is supplied.
observable_or_endpoint: A single model with cross-domain parameter transfer would be required even to pose the claim.
falsifier_or_next_test: Reject unless a declared model survives existing constraints and preregistered cross-domain tests.
limitations: Methodological analogy is not physical identity.
